levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن أبي ثور

notes: «ثم استقبل عمر الحديث يسوقه» — Ibn Abbas hands the account to Umar, who then speaks in it («قال كنت أنا وجار لي»). Per the narrated-encounter rule (owner ruling 5) Umar is the last link, after Ibn Abbas. The Prophet and his wives are scene only.
